comparison.objective: Lift a crate with two fork bars only after both are fully engaged and keep it level.
comparison.physical_skill: Synchronize two support tools under a load and regulate level lifting.
comparison.success_condition: Both bars fully under the crate before lift and crate remains level; detailed thresholds are absent.
comparison.reason: It tests balanced two-point load support, not mandrel-guided notch fracture or released-fragment recovery.
